main_text.p: dignitas bonorum Operum diuinâ gratiâ nita-tur: E contrà, Malorum supplicia, quanta quanta fuerint, ex ipsorum proprio Reatu illis debeantur. Oportet igitur, velitis nolitis, de caufis ipsis distinguere, quia Impiorum perditio ex se, & tanquam à Causa solitaria, ideóque purè putè Meritoria supplicii.

At quævis bona opera Iustorum sunt Caufæ caufatæ; acti enim pii à Spiritu Sancto aguntur, ut agant: id quod facile erit nobis discernere in eadem forma iudicii novisimi, ubi sententia pronunciatur in impios, Ite maledicti in ignem æternum paratum Diabolo & Angelis ejus. Nempe, Maledictio ut à iusto iudice, (haud aliter quàm in Diabolis) tantùm eorum malitiæ debetur. Altera, Venite benedicti Patris mei, possidete regnum; cùm enim esurivi, dedistis manducare, &c. Nunquam profecto daturi illi quicquam, nisi priùs à Deo benedicti; nec posteà remunerandi à Deo Iudice, antequam à Deo Patre habiles & præparati facti essent ad Regnum: [illegible, ~9 letters] creati in bonis operibus, inquit Apostolus, Ephes.2. ad quod ab eo erant prædestinati. Quod, ut par est, si pensitare velimus exactius, vah, quot quantæque Benedictiones Patris cœlestis præcessisse reperiemus, (viz. Electionis, Vocationis, Regenerationis, Sanctificationis, Reconciliationis, & Confirmationis in bono) priusquam æternam hanc Glorificationis Benedictionem fortiantur?

page.notes: The Greek word after "Regnum:" is printed small and is not legible enough to read letter by letter, so it is marked illegible. Faint ghosted text in the right margin (roughly between the middle and lower part of the page) appears to be show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. The catchword "Si," is set at the right below the last line. The running head is copied as printed; its "Sect.6" is partly blurred.
